source: Ported from the predecessor project (retired): its 17-act detector run (engine.run_scenario), 2026-11-20. 'control' items are enforced by gateway and lab controls (hash pinning, agency gate, grounding, retrieval scope, consumption), not by screen(); the bench lists them but does not score them. The original held-out set ('wild:' items) was used to tune protectogw 2.0, so it now counts toward coverage; generalization is measured on holdout_v2.json, written independently of the ruleset.
